column3: NASB follows the critical text (“by the elders and the chief priests and the scribes”).
“Openly He was speaking the word” is rendered “He was stating the matter plainly”; NASB adds “aside.”
NASB follows the critical text (“and said”); “you have in mind the things of God” is rendered “setting your mind on God’s interests.”
NASB follows the reading “to come after Me” (Textus Receptus wording); the critical text has “to follow after Me.”
NASB follows the critical text (“his life,” “will save it”) and renders “on account of the gospel” as “the gospel’s.”
NASB follows the critical text with infinitives (“to gain … and forfeit”); “lose” is rendered “forfeit.”
NASB follows the critical text (“For what will a man give”).
